brief.audience: Top creator with a team, daily output and deadline pressure

slides.headline: One key / Every creative possibility
slides.takeaway: Introduce Antseed as access to video, image and voice models for creators.

slides.headline: Your ideas move fast. Your tools make you wait.
The cut needs more than one model.
slides.qualification: 60+ video and 35+ image models. Four USD price examples retained from the source: MiniMax H3, Veo 3.1 Fast, GPT Image 2 and ElevenLabs Turbo. Not live quotes; provider configuration and model availability vary.
slides.takeaway: For a 2am submission, choose video, image and voice models for every asset in the cut.

slides.headline: One provider fails. Find another route.
slides.qualification: Illustrative 01:48 workspace with submission due at 02:00, not measured live rendering progress. Provider A/B are conceptual routes for the same Veo hero-shot request. Failover requires a compatible, available provider; limits still apply.
slides.takeaway: Before the 2am submission, reroute a failed request to a compatible provider while other jobs continue.

slides.headline: One key for the cut. Less setup. More time.
slides.qualification: Antseed Gateway manages per-editor/project keys, budgets, caps and usage. Gateway docs button links to the existing official Gateway documentation.
slides.takeaway: Use one Gateway workflow key and endpoint across models; per-editor access and shared billing support the team.

slides.headline: The network, in numbers.
slides.qualification: Latest displayed homepage snapshot at retrieval. Provider count matches lifetime.sellers in the public network-summary API. The participant count sums roles and may count one address more than once. Tokens include paid and free usage. CC BY 4.0 attribution retained.

slides.headline: Your shot. Live. Book a call.
slides.qualification: Book a Call is the sole closing link, using the user-provided Ravi Calendly URL. The requested co-launch/placement and program-terms lines are removed. The small rewards card retains eligible usage and referrals only.

editorial_decisions: Cover uses a general product title; the following Problem and Solution pages carry the concrete pain points and 2am deadline scenario.
Slides 3–5 share one scenario: submission due at 2am. The requirements are model access, compatible-provider rerouting and one-key access through Antseed Gateway.
Three illustrated model cards retain four historical source-pitch price examples and the user-approved 35+ image-model label.

Slide 4 replaces the watercolor master with native dark framing, icons and the unchanged model-usage chart. The original laptop ant is retained at x1084/y490 with height164. No watercolor appears in mobile mode either.
Live stats replace the supplied historical snapshot; both the source display time and actual refresh time are shown.

Closing action is Book a Call at https://calendly.com/ravi-antseed. Get your key, Gateway docs and the raw antseed.com link are removed from the closing slide. Gateway docs remains on the team-control slide.
Co-launch/featured-placement and program-terms copy is removed from the closing reward card at the user’s request.
All exports, Vercel and the connected GitHub copy are refreshed together. The shortened neobank deck retains its original historical framing.

At user request, the stats slide shows only the data-as-shown date. Refresh timestamp, CC BY attribution and metric-methodology lines remain in source metadata, not on the slide; the orphaned asterisk is removed.

Storyline eyebrows are exactly Problem, Solution or Action. The first content slide uses a descriptive headline instead of repeating Problem. Network stats supports Solution; the final Action slide retains three concrete actions.

Brand audit corrects token colors, round-dot rails, button components, radii, cover punctuation/tracking, night ant lighting and figure shape. Content, models, prices, dates, 2am example and three closing actions remain approved.
